ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast macro distribution; visible ventral surface is approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels and 15% low-intensity black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous white blobs forming the left and right lobes; a central high-contrast black vertical band extending from the median notch to the peduncle area; a thick, continuous black border along the entire trailing edge; small black focal specks scattered on the inner lower regions of both white lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a narrow vertex; estimated interior angle of approximately 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the full trailing edge; right lobe (viewer perspective) exhibits higher pixel-amplitude variations and deeper valleys compared to the left lobe; distal tips transition into irregular textured masses.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory curving upwards and outwards from the central notch to the lateral tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Minor dark pixel mottling clusters visible on the lower medial white regions of both lobes; no high-contrast white circular rosettes detected on black regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three to four distinct vertical high-contrast white linear marks (rake marks) localized on the central black band; one diagonal dark linear mark on the lower inner quadrant of the left lobe (viewer perspective).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive brown/tan textured barnacle colonization on the extreme distal tips of both lobes; prominent vertical white linear rake marks on the central peduncle-fluke junction.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy cluster-style barnacle fringe on the lobe terminals; distinct boundary separation between the central black pigmentation and the white lobe surfaces.
